editions.heading: Which Edition Should You Buy?
editions.intro: Directive 8020 comes in three PC editions plus a PS5 version. Here's what each one includes, with a direct link to its store page.

cards.name: Standard Edition
cards.note: The full game: all 8 episodes, every branching choice and all endings. Everything you need for a first playthrough.

cards.name: Digital Deluxe Edition
cards.note: The game plus the Outfit Pack, the bonus mission “The Dark Pictures Heirlooms Retrieval”, the Cinematic Filter Pack, a digital artbook and the soundtrack.

cards.name: Digital Deluxe Upgrade
cards.note: For players who already own the base game: adds every Digital Deluxe extra to your copy. Does not include the base game.

cards.name: PlayStation 5
cards.note: The console version as a digital code for the PlayStation Store. Redeem it on your PS5 and download the game.

activation.heading: How to Activate Your Steam Key
activation.intro: Your key arrives by email right after checkout. Activating it takes less than a minute:

steps.title: Sign in to Steam
steps.body: Open the Steam client on your PC, or go to store.steampowered.com, and make sure you're signed in to the account you want the game on.

steps.title: Open the activation window
steps.body: In the client, click “Games” in the top menu and choose “Activate a Product on Steam”. In a browser, go to store.steampowered.com/account/registerkey.

steps.title: Paste your key
steps.body: Copy the code from your Instant Gaming email and paste it into the activation window, then confirm. Directive 8020 is added to your library.

steps.title: Download and play
steps.body: Install the game from your library and jump into Episode 1. If an error appears, double-check your account's region — that's the most common cause.

blocks.text: Instant Gaming has been selling game keys since 2010 and is one of Europe's largest key retailers. It buys keys in bulk from distributors and publishers — that's why prices sit below the Steam Store. Orders are delivered automatically by email within minutes, and if a key doesn't work, support replaces or refunds it.

The trade-offs are the same as with any key store: every key is tied to a region (check the compatibility list before buying), and once you reveal a key it usually can't be refunded. The listings linked on this page are genuine Steam keys — the game lands in your library exactly as if you had bought it on Steam.
The standard listings are sold for Europe, USA and Canada. Steam checks your account's country when you redeem a key, so a key for the wrong region simply won't activate.

items: Your account country is shown in Steam under “Account details” — that's the region that matters.
Every Instant Gaming product page has a country compatibility list showing which countries a key covers.
If the two don't match, pick a listing for your own region before buying.

blocks.text: For the lowest price, the PC Standard Edition is the way in: it includes the full game with every choice and all endings. On PS5 you pay console prices, since there are far fewer key sellers for console codes. Whichever version you pick, this site's walkthrough covers exactly the same content.

faqs.q: Where is the cheapest place to buy Directive 8020?
faqs.a: Key retailers are usually the cheapest option — Instant Gaming often lists Directive 8020 for 20-40% below the Steam Store price. Sales rotate, so check the live price on the product page and compare it with the current Steam sale.

faqs.q: Is Instant Gaming legit and safe?
faqs.a: Instant Gaming is a well-established key retailer operating for over a decade. Delivery is by email, payments go through standard providers, and if a key doesn't work, support replaces it. The usual caveat of any key store: a revealed key can't be refunded.

faqs.q: Do I get a Steam key or a full account?
faqs.a: You get a Steam key — a code you activate on your own Steam account. The game stays in your library permanently; nobody else keeps access to it.

faqs.q: Which region is the Steam key for?
faqs.a: The standard listing is sold for Europe, USA and Canada. Every Instant Gaming product page has a country compatibility list — check it against your Steam account's country before buying, because a key for the wrong region won't activate.

faqs.q: Can I buy Directive 8020 for PS5?
faqs.a: Yes. The PS5 version is sold as a digital code for the PlayStation Store. Redeem it on your console (PlayStation Store → Redeem Code) or through account management on the web, then download the game.

faqs.q: What does the Digital Deluxe Edition include?
faqs.a: The base game plus the Digital Deluxe extras: The Dark Pictures Outfit Pack, the bonus mission “The Dark Pictures Heirlooms Retrieval”, the Cinematic Filter Pack, a digital artbook and the digital soundtrack. If you already own the base game, get the Digital Deluxe Upgrade instead.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund on a game key?
faqs.a: Revealed keys are generally non-refundable — that's standard for key retailers. If the key itself is faulty, Instant Gaming support will replace it. It's the trade-off for paying less than Steam's price, where a 2-hour refund window applies.

faqs.q: Does buying through this guide's links cost me more?
faqs.a: No — the price is identical to visiting Instant Gaming directly. We earn a small commission on each sale, which keeps this guide free. It never changes what you pay.
